## Exact producer/consumer and selective-proof table

Every distinct operation below must reject error-only and otherwise-valid partial-output/error, with an injected diagnostic plus intended operation/status assertion. rg/grep0 means match,1 means clean absence interpreted by the policy,>=2 means execution failure. sed/awk/sort/wc and any retained tr/cat producer require0. Do not merge stderr into successful source/count data. Preserve errors even if payload already contains a policy violation or all expected allowed rows.

| Operation | Frozen completion/empty rule | Reachable selective injection |
|---|---|---|
| Comment stripping | Complete checked sed output before any consumer; empty text allowed where its consumer permits | Dispatch source and a later registered/discovered file, earlier reads successful; emit exact valid stripped content then fail |
| Dispatch fixed check | Both files separately; matching expression required; failure distinct from clean absence | Target scalar after vector passes; correct expression plus error and error-only |
| fma-body extraction and forbidden-body predicate | Checked awk; body required nonempty; clean no forbidden config allowed | Correct full body then awk error; independently target later safe-body rg with error after earlier bodies pass |
| Registry production/list extraction/sort | Capture complete constant registry before parsers/loops; exact lines retained | Cat/registry output if still fallible, filename awk and sort independently emit exact valid rows then fail |
| Initial whole-tree candidate discovery | All four roots; capture complete rg -l output before sorted registration validation | Full-looking list containing both registered files, then error; independent sort error |
| Comment-stripped occurrence extraction/count | Capture checked sed then rg -o; rg1 yields legitimate0, never an execution-error0; check wc and any retained tr | Later file after earlier valid file; exact occurrences then rg error; correct7/1 count then count-tool error. Distinguish phases if function reused |
| Registration membership predicate | Exact fixed whole-line match required only for candidates with real calls | Feed valid registered candidate; membership tool prints matching row then errors. Do not let clean no-match and execution failure share a false success |
| Registered per-file validation and marker-window awk | Each required file exists, actual count matches registry; empty unmarked result is valid | Later registered file, correct count then failure; safe empty/partial marker output then awk error |
| Registry aggregate parser | Complete checked awk over checked registry; declared total8 | Emit8 then fail; cannot accept numeric payload alone |
| Tree recount | Same complete roots/pattern; each file count completes before sum; zero-call/prose legal, final total8 mandatory | If separately discovered, target SECOND rg discovery after first succeeds; later count returns correct count then fails. If one checked list reused, still independently test the later recount consumer |
| Retired definition predicate | Required softfma.rs; clean absence valid, match forbidden, read/search errors fatal | Reach final predicate with valid eight-call tree; error-only and plausible output/error; source missing with otherwise valid fixture |

No requirement for redundant scans: reuse ONE checked candidate list if desired. Keep registry-sum and tree occurrence recount independent in what they count; never replace tree recount with the registry total or registry-only file list. Reusing the candidate list removes the second discovery obligation, not the recount's per-file status obligations. Use gate_count_lines over checked occurrence output if convenient (empty input ->0); this can eliminate tr as a production operation. Tests target the actual final implementation operations rather than forcing removed commands to remain.
